title: U.S. Pool Supply Octopus Suction Pool Cleaner, Inground Automatic Pool Vacuum Cleaner with Hose - Swimming Sweeper Vac Cleaning Suction-Side Cleaners - Auto Creepy Sweeps Removes Debris, Leaves Cleans
features: A professional, powerful, and quiet automatic suction pool vacuum cleaner that quickly cleans your entire pool without missing spots. It is an efficient, durable, and quiet vacuum cleaning system with a long-life diaphragm membrane. The diaphragm eliminates the annoying flapper hammer noise that other flapper vacuum cleaners have. Replacement diaphragm included.

The innovative vacuum design has incredible suction power, so it can quickly and easily clean your entire pool. It thoroughly cleans and removes all pool debris as it moves across floors, climbs up walls, and around steps without getting stuck. The unique deflector wheel helps prevent it from getting caught on steps, ladders, and corners!

This professional cleaner is ideal for use in in-ground pools and some above-ground and self-supporting swimming pools (excluding soft-wall and vinyl-lined pools). It only requires a 1/2 HP pump or a minimum flow of 1,000 gal/hour (3.8 m³/hour) to operate. It's easy to install, as no tools are required.

Includes 33 feet of premium spiral wound vacuum hose (20 - 20" hose sections). The hose sections allow you to customize the hose length to the requirements of your pool. The hoses are designed with a snug, secure fit to prevent leaks, and the hose sections can be connected much easier to each other if the ends are dipped in water first. Hoses become more flexible after use.

U.S. Pool Supply provides professional, high-quality, affordable pool cleaning, maintenance supplies, and accessories. We offer all the essential items needed to help residential pool owners care for and maintain their pools so that they can eliminate the need for expensive scheduled pool service technicians.
